scope: Native public-benchmark acquisition for S2 thesis evaluation. Offline only; NOT mixed into production telemetry.
policy: Raw archives stored locally under analysis/benchmark/data/ and excluded from git (see .gitignore). Only this manifest, hashes, and analysis code are committed.

datasets.citation: B. Saha and K. Goebel (2007), 'Battery Data Set', NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA.
datasets.ground_truth: Per-cycle discharge Capacity (Ah) → End-of-Life at 70% of rated 2.0 Ah = 1.4 Ah. Supports RUL regression with real failure labels.
datasets.notes: Canonical NASA battery prognostics benchmark. 1-min sampling; charge/discharge/impedance cycles per cell.

datasets.publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (FDD research collection)
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (per Data.gov catalogue listing; confirm on landing page before redistribution).
datasets.ground_truth: Filename-encoded fault class + severity (labeled). Supports supervised fault-detection evaluation (precision/recall/F1/FAR).
datasets.domain_limitation: RTU != production PAC. Concept/feature mapping only where physical meaning, unit, sampling, and context are compatible. Do NOT transfer thresholds directly to production PAC.
datasets.notes: Simulated + ORNL field + lab-field. Simulated set shares a single column schema; field sets differ.

verification.method: HTTP 200 + non-zero archive size + sha256 + unzip integrity test + artifact count
